title: When there is no answer, and when every number is

ask.text: Say what the Sill is holding: one footing, an always, or a refusal.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Keep taking off both pans and see what is left standing.
Opened, the near pan is exactly what the far pan already was.
